label: 86 Chaos 17.0.18
releaseTitle: Release Gate Schedule Subprocess Timeout Repair
notes: Separates the local Schedule publication Node/React checks from the mobile layout Playwright smoke inside the full release-gate harness so Playwright is not launched through a second nested npm lifecycle.
Launches the mobile layout smoke directly through the installed @playwright/test CLI under the observable runner with its own timeout and heartbeat.
Classifies observable-runner exit code 124 as a timeout before parsing TAP text, so harmless summary lines such as fail 0 can never become the reported blocker.
title: 86 Chaos 17.0.18

description: Keeps application and schedule behavior unchanged while splitting the nested mobile Playwright subprocess from schedule publication source/UI checks and making timeout reporting authoritative.
